variantPolicy: A grouped request can contain multiple variants. No count of individually implemented vehicles is inferred.

An artist reference variant does not validate the complete requested group.
The M1025 alias overlaps the Humvee family but remains a separate explicit request.
The earlier generic vehicle requests and the additional metro remain in scope.
